title: Choose the landing page's structure
question: Three ways to arrange the same world and the same proof, for an organizer arriving cold. The roll leads with the rail.

options.label: The Rail
options.thesis: The page is one ticket's life, hung on the same rail as the Events page.
options.viewport: Headline and the organizer action at left; five stops on the rail at right, each carrying one real figure.
options.risk: Reads as the Events page in a costume unless each stop earns its own proof.

options.label: One Signature
options.thesis: A thousand tickets drawn as a thousand marks, one of them lit: the signature that made them.
options.viewport: A 40 by 25 field of marks fills the right two thirds; the headline, three measured figures and the action sit at left.
options.risk: Impressive but abstract, so it must say what the thousand are within one glance.

options.label: The Split
options.thesis: One resale, itemised: who was paid what, as a receipt the organizer can read in two seconds.
options.viewport: The headline and the action at left; a single resale receipt with its three shares as a proportional bar at right.
options.risk: The most direct answer, and the most like a fintech page if the receipt is set too glossily.
